ideas.title: Minnesota Nonprofit Theft and Fraud Cases on the Rise
ideas.description: Investigate the recent string of nonprofit theft and fraud cases in Minnesota, including the $220K theft from a suicide prevention nonprofit.
questions: What are the common factors among these cases?
How can nonprofits prevent similar theft and fraud?
ideas.insight: This story would highlight the need for increased oversight and regulation within Minnesota's nonprofit sector.

ideas.title: Systemic Issues within Minnesota's Group Home Industry
ideas.description: Investigate the systemic issues within Minnesota's group home industry, including regulatory oversight and potential causes of the fifty reported deaths.
questions: What are the root causes of these deaths?
How can regulatory oversight be improved?
ideas.insight: This story would shed light on potential systemic issues within Minnesota's group home industry and the need for reform.
